passes.note: F-002 resolved: dev_memory_finish docs present exactly three modes (Outside Koala, Story-candidate write, Global promotion); --storyId documented as target override within story-candidate write, not a fourth mode. F-003 resolved: dev_memory_start section header explicitly says 'not lifecycle worktree initialization', body states 'does not start or advance any story phase', CLI engine description says '不是生命周期 dev_start，不创建 worktree 或推进 phase'. Non-authoritative disclaimer and gate-evidence exclusion confirmed in docs. verify-dev-memory.mjs 51/51 pass.

All 6 conceptual design boundaries verified. (1) gateEvidence:false + authority:non_authoritative enforced structurally in schema, createEntry(), and validateEntry() - machine-checkable at every read/write path. (2) dev-memory handlers import zero story lifecycle code; no story_advance/create path reachable. (3) Story-candidate mode writes to .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/dev-memory-candidates.jsonl; auto-injection path validates story exists via store.readStory. (4) Global promotion strictly requires explicit --scope=global; CLI auto-injection is skipped when scope=global, preventing active-story branch from bypassing it. (5) dev_memory_start is separate from lifecycle dev_start - dev_start is an internal handler NOT in MAIN_TOOLS, so no CLI collision. (6) dev_memory_finish has exactly the three intended modes (outside-Koala / story-candidate / global-promotion); all 51/51 verify-dev-memory.mjs checks pass. dev_memory_* command policies have no gateEvidence:true. Minor advisory (non-blocking): explicit --storyId + --scope=global combination silently uses story-candidate mode since schema documents scope as applicable only when no storyId.

Quality review pass: core/dev-memory.ts + handlers/dev-memory.ts + command-policy.ts + cli-engine.ts boundary rule 4 are cohesive; schema validation enforces gateEvidence=false/authority=non_authoritative at every read/write; regex escape in search prevents injection; ownership classes correctly distinguish project-memory writes (mainSharedMutating) from story-candidate writes (storyScopedMutating) with dynamic promotion of --scope=global to mainSharedMutating; docs explicitly forbid gate-evidence use and separate dev_memory_start from lifecycle dev_start; npm --prefix packages/main run build clean; node scripts/verify-dev-memory.mjs 51/51 pass; git diff --check clean. Non-blocking advisories (not filed): (1) dev_memory_list --scope=story-candidate silently falls back to project memory instead of scanning candidate files; (2) generateId sha7 could collide on identical category/summary/trigger in same millisecond (would silently dedup on next read).
